Run 2: 要又一个次搬了家：要再搬一次家，With a modal verb expressing a future plan, use 要 + 再 + verb + number + measure word + object. 再 marks a repetition that has not happened yet, and completed-action 了 is not used after 要.
Run 3: 要又一个次搬了家：要再搬一次家，With a modal verb for an action that has not happened yet, use 要 + 再 + verb + number + measure word + object. 再 expresses a future repetition, and completed-action 了 is not used here.
